Rational bidders will likely bid close to their values to maximize profit. To avoid overbidding and losing profit, I should bid conservatively, below my value. This minimizes potential loss, as winning would result in a negative payoff if the third-highest bid is higher than my value. Given my value of $26, I aim to bid slightly below my value to ensure potential profit. Assuming rational behavior from Andy and Betty, they will bid near their values. To maximize profit, I will bid $25.9, slightly below my value, ensuring I win if their bids are lower or equal, while minimizing losses if I win. This strategy balances the risk of overbidding with the potential profit from winning at a lower cost.
